synopsis: The booklet identifies Speedgoat with Simulink Real-Time as a hardware-and-software HIL offering, alongside other replay and HIL options [f8364, f16036]. These commercial tools provide turnkey real-time targets tightly coupled to Simulink, which is also their listed interface [f8645, f9229, f9231]. Speedgoat engineering services supports real-time and HIL integration around Simulink Real-Time, but the cited evidence is general HIL rather than off-road-specific [f8814, f9230]. No public price was found, leaving a procurement-cost gap [f8647, f9232]. The latest release found for the combined entry was Pulse, dated 15 May 2025; separately, the glossary places Simulink Real-Time in the twice-yearly MATLAB and Simulink release family and identifies R2026b as its second 2026 release, without establishing an updated release date for the combined entry [f9233, f16239].
